Text.Page:
[EN] Hey! You look like you can handle yourself. Can you give me a hand?

I'm supposed to be mining shards, but those {@LinkCreature:49#2}s and {@LinkCreature:49#101}s will tear me to bits.

Tell you what—if you clear those blasted kelba refiners away, I'll pay you in {@RawItem:206811}s.
[ES] ¡Oye! Tienes pinta de poder cuidarte solo. ¿Me echas una mano?

Supongo que debo extraer fragmentos, pero esos {@LinkCreature:49#2} y {@LinkCreature:49#101} van a hacerme añicos.

Mira, si despejas a esos malditos kelba refiners, te pagaré con {@RawItem:206811}.

[EN] See, this is why you're a soldier and I'm a miner. You lived. I wouldn't have.

As promised, here's your payment. I picked out the best ones for you.
[ES] Ves, por esto tú eres un soldado y yo un minero. Sobreviviste. Yo no lo habría hecho.

Como prometí, aquí tienes tu pago. Escogí los mejores para ti.
